# Acme Book 14 Service Manual

<!-- page: 60 -->
## Battery pack

The battery is a customer-replaceable unit secured by two screws. Replacement packs are available under part number AB-BAT-57.

<!-- page: 68 -->
## Storage drive

One M.2 2280 slot supports NVMe or SATA solid-state drives. A 2.5-inch SATA hard drive bay is also available.

<!-- page: 72 -->
## Memory modules

The computer has two SO-DIMM DDR4 memory slots and supports up to 32 GB of memory. No memory is soldered to the system board.

## Keyboard

Remove the base cover before removing the keyboard. The keyboard is a field-replaceable unit.
